name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2108: Two CI failures tonight were flakes, not regressions, and both had one shape: a fixed waitForTimeout followed by an evaluate that reads a board global the 5.9MB page has not built yet. When the runner is loaded the global is absent, the customary fallback swallows it, the fixture seeds nothing, and the test reports a PRODUCT defect that is really the harness arriving early. v592 seeded an empty runeword ledger and then accused the loot filter; v559 read a toast before it existed. Both fixed at the cause. A sweep found 51 more specs with the same shape - a ratchet now stops that number growing, and a boardReady helper is the way to pay it down.
